Senior Backend Engineer, Payments
Fabrikam Logistics · Remote (US)

About the role
Fabrikam Logistics moves freight for 2,000 shippers. Our payments team builds the services that invoice shippers and pay carriers.

What you'll do
- Design and build APIs for invoicing and carrier payouts
- Own services from design to on-call
- Improve reliability and observability across the payments platform
- Mentor engineers on the team

What we're looking for
- 5+ years building backend services
- Strong Python or Go
- Experience with PostgreSQL and event-driven systems (Kafka)
- Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure as code (Terraform)

Nice to have
- Experience with payments or ledgers
- Kubernetes
- gRPC

Apply at https://careers.example.com/fabrikam/backend-payments
